name: source-tab-code-action
goal: Every catalog opens details without a code action; only the detail Source tab offers View code in a revision-specific modal.

evidence: User correction: code belongs only inside entity Source tabs, opened in the existing modal; no actions on catalogs or detail headers.

Reports entity-preview-source and Desktop entity-source-code scenarios previously required catalog/header actions. Strengthened the same category/viewport scenarios and card assertions to constrain entry point, lazy modal rendering, focus, revision and failures.
